AgentAccess.description:
Agent access as the settings page needs it. Two of the three fields are facts about
how the server was started, which no stored row can hold: without them the page
could not explain why a choice does nothing.

ceiling.description:
The most this server allows, from `KEEPSAKE_MCP`. `off` means agent access is
unavailable here, whatever is chosen.

media.description: Images and audio clips asked with the question, in display order.
Images and audio clips asked with the question, in display order.

McpMode.description: Ordered from least to most capable: `min` with a ceiling can only lower it.

MediaUpload.description:
A stored file, before or after it is attached to a question. Describes what is
served: AVIF for images and AAC in MP4 for clips.

NewDevice.description: The endpoint and keys of a browser's PushSubscription.

media.description:
Uploaded images and audio clips asked with the question, in display order.
Omitted when empty, so share snapshots of text-only facts are unchanged.

NewQuestionMedia.description: An upload to attach to a new fact's question, in display order.

alt.description: Describes an image for screen readers without giving away the answer.

public_key.description: The VAPID application server key, base64url-encoded.

QuestionMedia.description: An image or clip shown with a question. Fetch its bytes from `/media/{media_id}`.

devices.description: Subscribed browsers that receive this profile's reminders.

minute_of_day.description: The earliest local reminder time, in minutes after midnight.

timezone.description: The study timezone that defines the local day.

due.description: Learning, relearning and review targets ready now.

new_available.description: New targets waiting within today's remaining intake. The queue offers them after due work.
